stages.name: first phase
stages.note: Each club plays the other 11 three times.

stages.name: championship group
stages.note: Top six; one match against each group rival.

stages.name: relegation group
stages.note: Bottom six; last is relegated, second-to-last goes to the play-off.

playoff.entries: 11th of the Super League vs 2nd of the Challenge League
playoff.note: Played 1 and 4 June 2027. The 12th-placed club is relegated directly. Same tie as the Challenge League promotion play-off.
The champion is promoted; 2nd plays the Super League 11th over two legs. The bottom club is relegated directly with no bottom play-off.

boundaries.note: Challenge League champion up directly, runner-up in a two-legged tie against the Super League 11th. Super League 12th down directly, 11th only through that tie. One shared place.
Simple 1-up/1-down: Promotion League champion (subject to licensing) replaces the Challenge League's bottom club. The Promotion League also relegates its bottom two to the regional 1. Liga Classic.

notes: C1: 12 clubs, 33 rounds (triple round robin) then a 6+6 split for 5 more = 38, points carried; 12th relegated, 11th in a two-legged play-off against the Challenge League runner-up (1 and 4 June 2027). C2: 10 clubs, 36 rounds (four meetings); champion up, runner-up to the play-off, bottom club down directly - no bottom play-off. CHPR: 18 clubs, 34 rounds; champion up subject to professional licensing; bottom two down to the regional 1. Liga Classic (level 4, not modelled, hence closed_down=true). Reserve teams are allowed in the Promotion League but cannot be promoted. Season 24 July 2026 - 30 May 2027.
